answer: In a market for reef surveys, marble inspections and summit maps, burn an admission fee F for every identity and cap its lifetime registration rewards at S, with S < F. Record the remaining allowance on-ledger; transferring or renaming an account cannot reset it. A farm opening n aliases to harvest subsidies loses at least n(F-S), while further income must come from independently verified, customer-funded jobs. This deters signup farming, though it also charges honest newcomers.
